article.headline: Microsoft Falls 2.8% Before Ignite As Software Stocks Retreat
article.deck: The Nov. 4 breakout past the 553.82 buy point has stalled: the stock trades 9.1% under it and below its 50-day line, so there is no entry until it rebuilds.
body: Microsoft fell 14.44, or 2.8%, to 503.55 as of 11:48 a.m. Mountain. The stock cleared a 51-week deep cup, 36.9% deep, at a 553.82 buy point on Nov. 4, a session that traded 2.3x its 50-day average volume. Nine sessions later it sits 9.1% below that buy point and well under the 581.51 top of the buy range. Today it is on pace for 0.88x its 50-day average volume.

That makes it a stalled breakout. The stock broke its 50-day line today, now 3.1% below the 519.55 average, and sits 4.1% under the 21-day line at 525.03, -0.61 ATRs from the 21-day line. It is 9.9% off its 559.15 52-week high and still 13.9% above the 200-day line. The RS line is 9.7% below its high, and Microsoft ranks 64 of 99 on the desk's list. The stock is up 4.1% this year and down 1.3% over the past year.

The business is not the problem on the numbers given. The September quarter earned 4.92 a share, up 32.3% from a year earlier, on revenue of $92.28 billion, up 18.8%. Earnings ran 5.16, 4.27 and 4.81 in the three quarters before. The market cap is $3.74 trillion at 20.8 times forward earnings. The next report is due Jan. 27.

GuruFocus reported that Microsoft moved lower before its Ignite event as Anthropic disclosed a $47.2 billion compute floor. Investor's Business Daily reported software stocks retreated on inflation worries and a new OpenAI model, and Yahoo Finance covered service outages at JPMorgan, Microsoft, United and the FAA.
A recovery of the 50-day line would put the stock back in the base; a slide toward the 200-day line would turn it into a new base.
article.watch: Whether Microsoft can close back above its 519.55 50-day line.

article.headline: Amgen Holds Near Its High As Healthcare Leads A Weak Tape
article.deck: Amgen trades 2.6% above its 447.13 cup buy point and inside the buy range that runs to 469.49.
body: Amgen slipped 3.67, or 0.8%, to 458.65 as of 11:48 a.m. Mountain while the indexes fell more than 1%. The stock broke out of an 8-week cup, 16.2% deep, at a 447.13 buy point on Oct. 22, a session that traded 1.11x its 50-day average volume. Eighteen sessions later it is 2.6% above the buy point and inside the buy range, which tops out at 469.49. Today it is on pace for 0.35x its 50-day average volume.

The trend is intact. The stock sits 0.7% above the 21-day line at 455.24, 0.0 ATRs from the 21-day line, and 7.4% above the 50-day line at 427.12. It is 5.2% below its 483.99 52-week high. The RS line is at its high, and Amgen ranks 90 of 99 on the desk's list. Shares are up 40.1% this year and 36.2% over the past year. Healthcare leads the desk's groups with an average RS of 67, and 71% of its names trade above their 50-day lines.

The September quarter earned 7.08 a share, up 19.4% from a year earlier, on revenue of $10.37 billion, up 8.5%. Earnings climbed in each quarter given, from 2.45 to 3.34, 4.37 and then 7.08. The market cap is $248.18 billion at 18.3 times forward earnings. The next report is due Feb. 2.
A close back under the 447.13 buy point would put the breakout in question; a push past 469.49 would take the stock out of the buy range.
article.watch: Whether Amgen holds the 21-day line at 455.24 and stays inside the 447.13-469.49 buy range.

article.headline: Spotify Eases 1.7% After Price-Target Hike On AI Remixing Prospects
article.deck: Spotify trades 4.4% above its 576.10 cup buy point, near the 604.91 top of the buy range.
body: Spotify fell 10.16, or 1.7%, to 601.57 as of 11:48 a.m. Mountain. The stock broke out of a 7-week cup, 18.4% deep, at a 576.10 buy point on Oct. 22, a session that traded 3.1x its 50-day average volume. The cup formed after a bigger correction, and the stock is still below the 748.30 high of Aug. 15, 2025. Eighteen sessions after the breakout it sits 4.4% above the buy point, just under the 604.91 top of the buy range. Today it is on pace for 0.44x its 50-day average volume.

The stock is 2.5% above the 21-day line at 586.85, 0.57 ATRs from the 21-day line, and 10.2% above the 50-day line at 545.80. It is 8.1% below its 654.68 52-week high. The RS line is 14.7% below its high, and Spotify ranks 83 of 99 on the desk's list. Shares are up 3.6% this year and down 5.4% over the past year.

The quarters are mixed. The September quarter earned 2.48 a share, down 24.4% from a year earlier, while revenue rose 16.3% to 4.97 billion euros. Earnings have fallen in each quarter given, from 4.43 to 3.45, 2.61 and 2.48, while revenue has climbed every quarter. The market cap is $123.64 billion at 35.1 times forward earnings.
Investor's Business Daily reported Monday that Spotify got a price-target hike on its AI remixing prospects.
A close past 604.91 puts the stock out of the buy range; a slip under 576.10 would stall the breakout.
article.watch: Whether Spotify closes above or below the 604.91 top of its buy range.
